[gifenc](https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc), version 1.0.3, MIT license.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/gifenc/-/gifenc-1.0.3.tgz

Package integrity (verified before extraction): `sha512-xdr6AdrfGBcfzncONUOlXMBuc5wJDtOueE3c5rdG0oNgtINLD+f2iFZltrBRZYzACRbKr+mSVU/x98zv2u3jmw==`.
